name: Local boundary evidence and shared whole-instance set optimization
hypothesis: Independent vertex decisions discard local surface-boundary evidence; joint set inference can remove incoherent false completions without changing native identity or geometry.
same_inputs: original source frames, native DINO features, RGB, frozen geometry, observation membership, parent unary, surface topology
additional_training: 24 disjoint official-training ScanNet rooms; instance labels only for learned edge affinity and the shared parent head; rendered training observations
calibration: 4 separate rooms, complete-carrier selected-set IoU; strengths 0, 1, 4, 16; no benchmark threshold fitting
solver_selection: Global binary Potts cut retained after comparison with soft Laplacian on four non-calibration development rooms; both fixed and learned conditions use the same solver
shared_across_queries: one compiled graph and strength for text, image, 2D point and 3D point whole-instance readouts
typed_unaries: native identity and co-visible scope for text/image; exact-point-conditioned membership for positive points
unchanged_public_readers: category sets, category partitions, and source-assisted reference fitting keep their declared task contracts
not_assumed: weak pair affinity is a negative label
point supervision trains semantic query identity
score_interpretation: point scores are local conditional scores at MAP, not calibrated marginals; actual sets are explicit cut labels
unknown_policy: vertices outside the caller's evidence domain do not become negative unaries; inside-domain unaries remain fallible model estimates, including view-mask exclusions
evaluation: fresh full31-job common run for learned condition; nine-scene four-query fixed control; compare parent and retained v8, AP and actual IoU separately
decision: Promote only stable actual-set improvements without other-query or severe scene regressions; do not combine different conditions' best outputs

bounded_unknown_extension.rule: zero unary log-odds for offline-observed vertices outside query evidence; unchanged graph, strength and thresholds
bounded_unknown_extension.evaluation: eight previously opened, fit-disjoint rendered rooms
bounded_unknown_extension.result: learned condition actual IoU24.5238 to23.0607 percent; coverage gain accompanied by identity bleeding
bounded_unknown_extension.decision: rejected; no benchmark run or parameter expansion
